narrative.overview: A near-black field gives document content room to breathe. Opaque graphite groups related controls and results. White headlines and primary actions stand forward, while quiet grays keep supporting information legible.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground and opaque graphite surfaces
Regular Geist for reading and Geist Mono for technical content
White primary actions, icy blue focus, and small mint status signals
Static light behind the sign-in form and hairlines through reading areas

rules.name: The Small Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep mint to small marks and pair status with readable text.

rules.name: The Opaque Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate reading and work areas with tonal contrast and one-pixel rules. Keep the form and result surfaces opaque.

dos: Do reserve the bright fill for the primary action.
Do show keyboard focus with the offset icy blue outline.
Do keep generated Markdown readable as literal, wrapping text.
donts: Don't use colored glows, translucent surfaces, or decorative motion.
Don't use mint as a general accent or let a status dot stand alone.
